name: Hanekura Tomoe
source:
Age: Secret.

1 year ago, she resigned as a teacher and got married. Currently, she's a newbie wife. Her husband is working overseas, and to kill some time, she works part time as an instructor. For Taito, she was a very understanding woman, and he has opened his heart to her long ago. 

A bit childish, and loves messing around. Because of that, she was always very popular with children. When Taito was in elementary school, he told her that he's gonna marry her once he grows up. At the moment, she's frustrated.

[My husband's working overseas for a year now, of course I'll be frustrated!]

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=866228]Getchu[/url]]
